caseName: Union Stock Yards Co. of Omaha, Ltd. v. Mayhall & Neible
caseNameFull: Union Stock Yards Company of Omaha, Ltd. v. Mayhall & Neible, a copartnership, etc.
attorneys: Mr. Norris Brown and Mr. Irving F. Baxter for plaintiff in error. Mr. A. A. McLaughlin, Mr. Francis A. Brogan, Mr. Alfred G. Ellick, Mr. Anon Raymond, Mr. Bruce Scott and Mr. Byron Clark for defendants in error. [See post, 757.]

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction, upon the authority of § 237 of the Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of September 6,1916, c. 448, § 2, 39 Stat. 726; Jett Bros. Distilling Co. v. Carrollton, *732252 U. S. 1, 5-6.

Mr. Norris Brown and Mr. Irving F. Baxter for plaintiff in error. Mr. A. A. McLaughlin, Mr. Francis A. Brogan, Mr. Alfred G. Ellick, Mr. Anon Raymond, Mr. Bruce Scott and Mr. Byron Clark for defendants in error. [See post, 757.]
